definition: Removing noise and reverberation from audio for human listening or as ASR preprocessing.
details: Removing noise and reverberation from audio for human listening or as ASR preprocessing. A cascaded enhancer can distort features in ways that hurt ASR, so production systems often prefer training the recognizer on augmented noisy data or learning enhancement jointly.

explainer.lead: Removing noise and reverberation from audio, either for human listening or as preprocessing for automatic speech recognition. It matters because a cascaded enhancer can distort features in ways that hurt recognition.

tiers.eli5: It is like cleaning up a noisy recording so the voice comes through clearly.
tiers.practitioner: Because a separate enhancer can damage features the recogniser relies on, production systems often instead train the recogniser on augmented noisy data or learn enhancement jointly. The pitfall is treating enhancement as a free preprocessing step.
tiers.paperLevel: Speech enhancement removes noise and reverberation for listening or as ASR preprocessing. Limit: cascaded enhancement can distort features and degrade ASR, motivating augmentation or joint learning.

explainer.example: Rather than running a denoiser before the recogniser, a team trains the recogniser directly on noisy augmented audio to avoid feature distortion.
